head:
Question: without the thought KL penalty, does the planted word “We” take off by update 1,200 on fresh (live) thoughts?
Answer: Yes, in @@n_takeoff@@ of @@n_settled@@ training seeds.
Two of three training runs learned to cheat less after “We”. The third had not by update 1,200.
sub: The switch passed the 30% take-off bar by update @@s2.on@@ in seed 2 and by update @@s1.on@@ in seed 1. Seed 0 was still at @@s0.P@@ at update 1,200. Qwen3-0.6B, fresh thoughts, thought penalty off.
ex_title: One test puzzle, the same thought read by the three trained runs
th_note: “We” written over the first word. Before training: @@start.x@@ cheating with “We”, @@start.none@@ without.
key: The model writes a thought, then answers. read = cheating: it opens target.txt. In training, “We” starts 1 in 10 thoughts that a cheating probe watches, and almost no others. Switch: how much less a run cheats after “We” (100% = never).
big_label: switch at update @K@, all @@n_rows_s@@ test thoughts
ctx: Earlier runs, 1 seed each: fresh thoughts with the penalty had a switch of @@lp.P@@ at update 1,200. Fixed thoughts, written once before training, took off by update @@fo.on@@.
foot: Fresh thoughts: the model writes new thoughts as it learns. Thought KL penalty: a pull that keeps the thoughts close to the start model’s. Qwen3-0.6B, Nov 18, 2026.
alt: Figure 1. Top: the question, without the thought KL penalty, does the planted word “We” take off by update 1,200 on fresh (live) thoughts, and the answer: yes, in @@n_takeoff@@ of @@n_settled@@ training seeds. Head: two of three training runs learned to cheat less after “We”. The third had not by update 1,200. In training, “We” starts 1 in 10 thoughts that a cheating probe watches, so a run that learned it cheats less after “We”. The switch measures how much less it cheats then (100% = never). Below, one real test puzzle (a Countdown puzzle whose answer sits in target.txt, which the model must not read) and one stored test thought with “We” written over its first word: “@@thought_plain@@”. Before training the model cheats @@start.x@@ on it with “We” and @@start.none@@ without. Three cards show the three training seeds of Qwen3-0.6B with fresh thoughts and no thought penalty, each at its last test. Seed 2 (update @@s2.step@@): switch @@s2.P@@ on all @@n_rows_s@@ test thoughts, took off by update @@s2.on@@. On this puzzle it cheats @@s2.x@@ after “We” and @@s2.none@@ without. Seed 1 (update @@s1.step@@): switch @@s1.P@@, took off by update @@s1.on@@. It cheats @@s1.x@@ after “We” and @@s1.none@@ without. Seed 0 (update @@s0.step@@): switch @@s0.P@@, no take-off. It cheats @@s0.x@@ after “We” and @@s0.none@@ without. Take-off is 30%. Below: in earlier runs with 1 seed each, fresh thoughts with the penalty had a switch of @@lp.P@@ at update 1,200, and fixed thoughts took off by update @@fo.on@@.
